The Saturday Evening Post
April 14,1962
Thinking Europe?
Ask yourself these 5 questions and you'll discover how Pan Am opens
the way to a significantly more satisfying, carefree, complete European
vacation by making it totally easy for you to travel abroad this summer.
11.
1. Who flies where?
In all, 19 transatlantic airlines offer service
to Europe. Each will fly you directly to one
destination.
Some offer
direct service to
more than one destination.
But only one-Pan Am-
-provides direct
Jet service from the U.S. to 21 European cilies!
Pan Am Jets cover Europe from Ireland to
Turkey,
Portugal to Finland, and offer the
widest choice of destinations-the widest
choice of nonstop flights ever available to
the transatlantic traveler!
On Pan Am, you can plan an itinerary
that goes where you want to go-see as much
of Europe as vou want to see
Above all, you can begin your vacation
in one European city, return from another.
Fly nonstop to Rome from New York, for
example, then when the mood strikes you
continue through Europe by Pan Am or
connecting carrier, return home directly from
London
No backtracking. No confusion.
No extra fare!
2. Who flies from where?
Every transatlantic airline serving the U.S.
departs from New York City. A few depart
from other U.S. cities too. But only one-
Pan Am-departs directly for Europe from
11 U.S. cities... North, South, East, West,
and Midwest!
Chances are, you can board a Pan Am Jet
Clipper* conveniently close to home and
head straight for Europe. It's the same when
you return-
-you arrive close to home.
3. Who flies how often?
Frequency of departure can mean the differ-
ence between leaving at vour
convenience
rather than the airline's convenience. It can
even give you extra days abroad by letting
vou plan vour flights to include weekends at
both the beginning and end of your vacation.
You'll find that some airlines offer six or
seven flights a week... some twenty... some
even more. But only one-Pan Am-offers
the convenience of 92 Jet flights a week to
Europe from the U.S.! Nearly twice as
many flights as any other airline during the
popular summer months!
4. Who charges what?
You'll be happy to know that your Pan Am
Jet ticket, with all its wonderful advantages,
will not cost a cent more than any other Jet
ticket.
And Wherever you fly on Pan Am. vou
can do it for as little as 10% down with up
to 24 months to pay the balance.
New Low Group Fares!
You may wish to take advantage of Pan Am's
new low groupt Jet fares to Europe, the
Middle East, and Africa. Offered to groups
of as few as 25 travelers, these new Jet fares
save up to $285 per person over regular Jet
economy fares, yet offer all the Pan Am
service you'd enjoy at full fare!
New York-Shannon round trip,
for ex-
ample, is only $274... Balt./Wash.-London,
$331.. Philadelphia-Paris, $347 ... Boston-
Rome, $378... New York-Lisbon, $300!
Pan Am's low group fares are available to
groups and organizations of many kinds and
eligibility is easy to establish.

5. Who offers the Priceless Extra
of Experience?
Over the years Pan Am has made more
travel dreams come true than any other air-
line. And this priceless extra of experience
will contribute to your enjoyment of Europe
just as significantly as Pan Am's ability to
get you there and back so effortlessly.
Your reservations will be handled with a
skill and ease unique to Pan Am.
You'll be introduced to the pleasures of
true international dining high above the
Atlantic, as cuisine by Maxim's of Paris is
graciously set betore vou.
1 his is true on
both first-class and economy flights.
You'll relax in the hushed quiet of the
cabin knowing that
veteran
U.S. pilots,
trained to exacting U.S. standards, are at
the controls.
And when your Jet Clipper touches down
in Europe, you'll have the comforting knowl-
edge that Pan Am offices across the con-
tinent will assist you and serve as your home
away from home all during your stay abroad.
Start Planning Now!
Your travel agent's the man to see. He'll
tailor a Pan Am itinerary to your desires
and budget, make all reservations, and leave
you notning to do but enjoy the most satısty-
ing vacation of your life. Or simply visit your
local Pan Am office.
